setupChecklist: Everyone joins on their phone (QR code on the table screen, or tap a seat's NFC tag)
Choose Character cards and enter them in the facilitator's setup
Suspect and Location cards - record the draws privately in the setup
Sort the Clue cards by time and note who holds each interval
Swap numbers and save each other under character names
Mute every other notification on every phone
Table screen: tap to enable sound, then check the soundtrack says ready
